concerns.text: Task T011a verifies SHA‑256 checksums of downloaded files but never records those checksums under `data/`. Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires that every raw dataset be checksummed and the checksum stored in the repository. Absence of a dedicated checksum‑recording step violates the constitution.

Task T032b_model’s fallback logic returns *all* variance‑filtered taxa when no taxa meet the BH‑adjusted p‑value threshold. FR‑006 explicitly requires training the Random Forest on *top correlated taxa* identified within the training fold. Allowing an unrestricted fallback weakens the functional requirement and may invalidate the intended feature‑selection methodology.
